provider_types.openai: OpenAI Chat Completions and compatible services; base_url and api_key configurable
provider_types.openai_responses: OpenAI Responses API, always streaming; base_url and api_key configurable
provider_types.anthropic: Anthropic Messages; base_url and api_key configurable
provider_types.google-genai: Google GenAI generateContent; base_url accepts a gateway host root and the SDK appends /v1beta/models/<model>:generateContent
provider_types.vertexai: Google GenAI on Vertex, ADC-bound, not usable with a plain API-key gateway

protocol_contract.credential_priority: api_key direct field, then [providers.<name>.env] sub-table; shell environment variables are not read for credentials
protocol_contract.headless: kimi -p/--prompt runs non-interactively; --auto and --yolo are rejected in prompt mode; tools auto-approve in prompt mode; --output-format stream-json streams incremental events
